item.description: DRDO's indigenous engine can power next-generation cruise missiles, jet-powered kamikaze drones; technology mastered by only a handful of nations
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: Inside India's broken jobs market and why the 'cockroaches' are fed up
item.description: India's expanding higher education system produces millions of graduates annually. However, quality job creation has not kept pace with this educational growth. Many educated youth struggle to find stable, well-paying employment opportunities. This mismatch fuels widespread frustration and youth-led protests across the nation. The situation highlights a critical challenge for India's demographic dividend.
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.title: SC warns Punjab for ignoring 15-yr-old ruling on dues to Himachal Pradesh
item.description: The Supreme Court criticized Punjab for its resistance to implementing an old decree. Attorney General Venkataramani proposed a cashless settlement for power dues. Himachal and Haryana agreed to the proposal, while Punjab raised objections. The court warned Punjab of consequences if it fails to comply. A final decision is expected on August 12.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: 39 medals, top-five finish: India ends CWG 2026 with several historic firsts
item.description: With several medal-rich sports missing from the programme because of financial constraints in hosting the Games — after the event was moved from Victoria in Australia to Glasgow — expectations were lower than in previous editions. Even so, India found success in new events, celebrated new athletes and produced several landmark performances.

item.title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
item.description: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

item.title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
item.description: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: 'Counting fingers, not hearts': Shehzad Poonawalla mocks Rahul's Gen Z post
item.description: Shehzad Poonawalla criticised Rahul Gandhi's recent social media post. He interpreted Gandhi's gesture as counting corruption and bribes daily. Poonawalla accused the Gandhi family of extensive involvement in corruption. Rahul Gandhi had shared a Korean finger heart gesture on Friendship Day. This outreach aimed to connect with younger audiences on social media.
item.dc:creator: KARAN MANRAL

item.title: South Dakota angler breaks 56-year pumpkinseed record with 1lb catch
item.description: A routine fishing trip on South Dakota's Wall Lake turned into a record-breaking moment for teenager Jack Backman after he caught a one-pound pumpkinseed, setting a new state record. Thinking he had hooked a crappie, Backman was surprised to discover the rare catch. The fish beat a 12-ounce state record that had stood since 1970.

item.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leaked on X, reaches 5.9M accounts before removal
item.description: A high-quality bootleg of Spider-Man: Brand New Day ran on X for around seven hours on Friday, reaching 5.9 million accounts and drawing over 143,000 likes before Sony had it pulled. It follows a full leak of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey eight days earlier. Neither dented the numbers: Tom Holland's Spider-Man took roughly $168 million on opening day, beating Avengers: Endgame's 2019 record.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
item.description: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Rape victim forced to lick sputum by panchayat in Bihar; FIR filed
item.description: A woman was forced to lick sputum by a village panchayat in Begusarai. She had alleged rape by a co-villager on multiple occasions. The local council instead accused her of an illicit relationship. An FIR was lodged after a video of the incident went viral. Police are investigating the video and searching for the rape accused.
item.dc:creator: RAJIV KUMAR

item.title: Lamine Yamal's family struggles shaped his inspiring World Cup journey
item.description: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after Patrick's success
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Why Aaron Rodgers is CBS’s top choice to replace Tony Romo as analyst
item.description: Aaron Rodgers has emerged as the leading name in CBS’s search for a possible Tony Romo successor amid growing uncertainty around the network’s top NFL booth. This report explains how the Steelers quarterback entered the broadcasting conversation, what Awful Announcing reported, and why his television future remains far from certain despite public speculation linking him to a major analyst role.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Deshaun Watson throws six INTs in training camp amid QB battle with Shedeur Sanders
item.description: In the competition for the Cleveland Browns' quarterback position, Shedeur Sanders is reportedly taking the lead, demonstrating superior performance metrics compared to Deshaun Watson in early practice sessions. Watson has been hindered by interception issues during camp. However, wide receiver Jerry Jeudy appears to support Watson as the preferred starter. The coaching staff will have the final say in this pivotal decision.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Ramlila body asks 'Ramayana' makers to hold special screening before release
item.description: The Shri Ramlila Mahasangh requested a special preview screening of the upcoming Ramayana film. This demand aims to prevent any scenes that might offend Hindu sentiments. The organization warned of protests if their preview request is not accepted. The film's trailer features Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana. Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled for a Diwali 2026 release.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: 'CJP stands with students': Abhijeet Dipke backs Jharkhand protest
item.description: Students in Jharkhand continue protests over alleged recruitment exam irregularities. They demand a CBI probe into JPSC and JSSC examination discrepancies. Protesters have lost faith in the current CID investigation into the matter. They seek reforms in the recruitment process and action against responsible officials. The students warn of further escalation if their concerns are not addressed.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: Delhi lawyer in London reveals why she won’t return to India's corporate
item.description: Jasleen Kaur, a solicitor now thriving in London, has no plans to return to India for her corporate career. She appreciates the UK’s balanced approach to work-life integration, where employers honor personal time and work hours. This lifestyle allows her to explore her hobbies and nurture personal growth, starkly contrasting with the higher demands and lesser regard for employee welfare found in Indian corporate settings.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Locked, loaded ... and put on hold: Another bewildering Trump pivot on Iran
item.description: President Trump announced a halt to a threatened military strike against Iran for now. He cited requests from Iran and other nations for deal finalization. Diplomatic efforts are reportedly underway with mediators facilitating discussions between Washington and Tehran. Meanwhile, domestic political challenges and internal party criticism are growing for the President. Markets and allies closely watch these developments and policy shifts.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: India's deep-sea bet: Centre's 'Samudra Manthan' to churn crude — How it works
item.description: India is funding half the cost of deepwater oil and gas exploration wells. This new scheme aims to reduce reliance on imported energy supplies. The government will support sixty exploration wells over the next five years. This initiative encourages companies to explore previously avoided offshore areas. Shared infrastructure will also lower development costs for new discoveries.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: 5 women killed, 4 injured in lightning strikes in Jharkhand
item.description: Five women died and four were injured by lightning strikes in Jharkhand's Ramgarh and Godda districts. Three women were killed in Ramgarh while sowing paddy, and two died in Godda. The India Meteorological Department forecast heavy rainfall and thunderstorms for the next four days. A yellow alert has been issued for isolated thunderstorms and heavy rain across several districts.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: 'Got scholarship, took loan': CJP's Abhijeet Dipke on education expenses row
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke stated his US education was funded by a scholarship and loan. He also mentioned the Cockroach Janta Party will use crowdfunding for transparency. RTI activist Amit Tiwari questioned Dipke's father's financial capacity for US education. Tiwari filed complaints with the Election Commission and tax authorities regarding the organization. He also requested an inquiry into the financial assets of Dipke's father.

item.description: Pappu Yadav alleged an assassination attempt at his Delhi residence on Sunday. He claimed individuals threatened him and sought his death during a scuffle. This incident followed his participation in an Opposition skit regarding Ram Mandir donations. BJP leaders had filed complaints against Yadav for hurting religious sentiments. Police are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the reported clash.

item.title: Hyderabad: 17-year-old driver kills 55-year-old, crashes into 8 vehicles
item.description: A 55-year-old man died and another person was injured after a car crashed into multiple vehicles. The accident occurred on Sunday morning under Madhuranagar Police Station limits in Hyderabad. A 17-year-old boy was allegedly driving the car which first hit a two-wheeler. Seven other vehicles were also damaged in the collision which was captured on CCTV. The minor driver has been taken into custody by the police.

item.title: Bullion market: What will guide gold, silver prices this week?
item.description: Gold and silver prices are expected to trade within a narrow range this week. Investors await key US economic data, especially non-farm payrolls, for Fed policy direction. Purchasing managers' index data from major economies will also be closely monitored. Developments concerning the US-Iran conflict and crude oil supplies will influence sentiment. Analysts anticipate gold to trade between Rs 1.40-1.44 lakh per 10 grams.

item.title: New York's pied-à-terre tax has homeowners trying to dodge it. Here's why
item.description: Homeowners in New York City received alerts about the implementation of a new pied-à-terre tax. This tax requires individuals to demonstrate that their properties serve as primary residences to sidestep the added charge. It specifically affects high-value homes not utilized as the owner's primary dwelling. In response, many homeowners are gathering necessary documentation and engaging experts to help with the exemption application process.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: 'Job loss, financial stress': Pune family of 3 dies by 'suicide'; note found
item.description: A family of three in Pimpri allegedly attempted suicide by inhaling poisonous fumes. The father died at the scene, and his wife and daughter later succumbed to their injuries. Financial struggles and job loss were cited as reasons for the tragic incident. Police recovered a note detailing their severe financial crisis. Investigations are ongoing, and bodies have been sent for post-mortem.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: Is there a genetic 'silver spoon'? What your genes can, and can't, tell you
item.description: Genetics play a pivotal role in determining the predisposition to certain diseases, but they don't seal our fate. Factors such as lifestyle choices and environmental context heavily impact our overall health and life paths. A recent study on twins underscores the strong correlation between genetics and intelligence, as well as socioeconomic achievement, prompting a reevaluation of how we perceive privilege.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA JAISWAL

item.title: 'In map of India, our North East is missing': Medallist Lovlina felt ‘hurt’ in Glasgow
item.description: Lovlina Borgohain said she felt hurt after noticing India’s Northeast was missing from a map at a Glasgow restaurant during a celebratory dinner. The Assam boxer raised the issue with management, who acknowledged the mistake and promised to correct it. BFI president Ajay Singh said there was no confrontation, describing the incident as an aberration.

item.title: ‘Culture of Congress leaders’: BJP minister slams Nana Patole feet-washing video
item.description: A video shows Nana Patole supporters washing his feet during Gurupurnima celebrations. Maharashtra revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule criticized this Congress party practice. Bawankule stated it is the culture of Congress leaders to indulge in such acts. He questioned why they engage in practices that only bring criticism. The incident has drawn attention and political criticism on social media.
